content.text:
Search the user's system for any archives, logs, or files that contain AI conversation history/переписка с ИИ. Search very thoroughly in these locations:

1. C:\Users\x2\AppData\ - check for AI tool chat logs (opencode, cursor, claude, chatgpt, copilot, etc.)
2. C:\Users\x2\ - look for any .txt, .json, .md, .log, .html files that might contain conversations
3. D:\AI_Project\ - look for any conversation exports, chat logs, history files
4. D:\ - any folders with conversation archives
5. Check for browser export files, telegram exports of AI conversations
6. Look for files with names like "chat", "history", "conversation", "log", "переписка", "диалог", "чат" in any location
7. Check C:\Users\x2\Documents\ - any subfolders
8. Check C:\Users\x2\Desktop\ - any subfolders or relevant files
9. Look for any .7z, .zip, .rar archives that might contain conversation backups
10. Check C:\Users\x2\AppData\Local\ and C:\Users\x2\AppData\Roaming\ for AI tool data directories

Use both Get-ChildItem and pattern matching. Be very thorough - the user specifically wants their AI conversation history.
